revisions.note: Made the Acrobat a Townsfolk and changed the ability to target a player.
Official Chinese translation from the 集石 wiki; ability unchanged (checked 2026-09-24).

en.name: Acrobat
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.
en.flavor: Welcome, one and all, to the greatest show on earth.

revisions.v1: Each night*, if either good living neighbour is drunk or poisoned, you die.
revisions.v2024-10: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.
revisions.v2026-09: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.

zh.name: 杂技演员
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果当晚他醉酒或中毒，你死亡。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚*，如果与你邻近的存活善良玩家之一醉酒或中毒，你死亡。
revisions.v2024-10: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果他在今晚是或变得醉酒或中毒，你死亡。
revisions.v2026-09: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果当晚他醉酒或中毒，你死亡。

zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒杂技演员，让他选择一名玩家。如果当晚这名玩家醉酒或中毒，杂技演员死亡。
